verdict.rationale: cubic installs as a GitHub app, automatically reviews new pull requests, and posts review comments and threads that developers can reply to and that can be auto-resolved, so the core PR-integration story is documented. Inline placement is only implied by review threads, the 'in minutes' claim refers to setup rather than review turnaround, and nothing documents GitLab. missing for 10: GitLab app support, explicit documentation that comments are posted inline on diff lines, evidence of review latency within minutes, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the reviewer installs as a GitHub/GitLab app and posts reviews as native inline comments on my pull requests within minutes

citations.quote: Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.
To review a PR that was opened _before_ you installed the app, comment: `@cubic-dev-ai review this PR`.
